title: arm_update_recheck: 4-hour self-rearming timer allow-listed (round 4 leftover) runs while locked and hidden
trigger: Quill signed in, app locked or window hidden for hours
effect: Every 4 h recheck_for_updates sends a GitHub release query regardless of lock state; the timer re-arms itself from inside its own task by overwriting preferences.update_recheck
fix: Drive the recheck from the update stage (UpdateState::Idle/UpToDate with a held deadline Task) and skip while refused_while_locked, or wake on a quill::wake signal

title: twofa_step_done leaves typed 2FA passwords in the masked inputs
trigger: Finish a recovery, reset or login-email step (poll-driven, no window), then stay on the Status view
effect: current/new/check password text typed for the finished step stays in memory in the InputState entities until the next goto_twofa_view; status_check_password is shown on the Status view itself
fix: Make the form values part of the TwoFaBox::Open stage (cleared by replacing the stage) instead of long-lived entities cleared by hand from some paths

title: apply_video_edit leaks the encoded file when a message edit's replacement is gone
trigger: Edit a message, replace its video, open the video editor and press Done (transcode); cancel the message edit (or its replacement) before the encode finishes
effect: The MessageEdit arm returns early at both `let ... else { return; }` sites without removing `output` (the Tray arm does remove an editor copy), so the encoded mp4 stays in the quill-video-edits temp folder
fix: Own the encode result as a scratch::OwnedFile until it is stored in the replacement, so every early return drops (removes) it

title: set_decline/set_accept/set_time overwrite another suggested-post box held in the same Flow
trigger: Price box open in one window (text typed), then Decline or Accept is opened for another post from a chat window
effect: Flow::Decline replaces Flow::Price/PriceTime/Needs without a word, so the price box (and its typed value) disappears; set_grams_needed refuses in that case and says so, the other setters do not
fix: One shared rule: openers refuse (or queue) while another box is held, as set_grams_needed already does, instead of per-setter overwrite arms

title: VideoControlsState::demo_speed_open is an open/closed bool kept beside the speed menu's own state
trigger: Screenshot demo sets it true; the speed popover reads it once as default_open
effect: No user-visible bug: set only by demos/payments.rs, never cleared, read in media_viewer/playback.rs as default_open
fix: Pass the demo's open request through the demo setup (an Option<SpeedDial> hook) instead of a long-lived bool on the controls state
